content: MK remarks that it seems 'no accident' that the Baghdadi calligrapher Maʿrūf Khaṭṭāt was implicated with Ṣāʾin al-Dīn in the Hurufi attempt on Shāhrukh's life of 830/1427, nor that the Timurid prince most interested in Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's lettrism was the calligrapher-prince Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh, for whom Ṣāʾin al-Dīn wrote his R. Suʾl al-Mulūk at Bāysunghur's request; MK says much more research is needed.
